note: Every deterministic interlock, where it lives, and the exact source text that implements it. tests/test_firmware_safety.py fails if any source check stops matching. Source inspection is not bench verification: every gate's bench evidence is NOT MEASURED until an accepted inert session shows it.

gates.behavior: Leaving SAFE requires the switch; releasing it from any other state aborts to SAFE.
Launcher enters READY only after the rocket reports READY within 8 s; otherwise it aborts.
READY aborts if rocket telemetry stops for 2 s.
UDP launch is rejected with CMD_REJECT:dashboard_launch_disabled unless firmware is rebuilt with the opt-in.
Even with the opt-in, UDP launch is accepted only in READY.
Commands are ignored unless they come from the address that sent the shared-token HELLO.
The launch button must be held for 1 s with the switch still armed.

gates.gate: Rocket ARM requires IDLE and a healthy IMU
gates.behavior: ARM is refused (and now reported) otherwise.

gates.gate: Rocket IGNITE requires ARMED and a healthy IMU
gates.behavior: IGNITE is refused (and now reported) otherwise.

gates.gate: Rocket IGNITE requires the deploy flag
gates.behavior: IGNITE is refused unless the deploy timer has fired; see discrepancy D-017 for the ordering question.

gates.gate: Deploy trigger requires a non-IDLE state
gates.behavior: Handling an unarmed rocket cannot fire the deploy output.
IGNITE_FORCE exists only when BENCH_MODE is defined; the committed build does not define it.
Rocket refusals travel over UART as CMD_REJECT lines; the launcher forwards them and its own ABORT reasons to the dashboard CSV.
PID values outside 0-10 or malformed are rejected on both boards.
